Maya: Quick shoutout — huge thanks to @leo and @gina for staying late to untangle the staging convoy. Brought the demo back! :raised_hands: Pizza on me tomorrow.
Leo: glad we got it across the finish line. team effort. :pizza:
Gina: extra love for @sam's hotfix script — saved the day. Also, I'm claiming the first slice :hand:
Sam: that grep+tail -f combo felt heroic. napkin shortage noted. :joy:
Ashley: can we get a sticker for the ops wall? 'Staging Whisperer' incoming. :star2:
Maya: filing sticker request: https://forms.gle/abcd1234 (please add your mockup)
People Ops Bot: New sticker requests submitted will be reviewed on Wednesday. :spiral_calendar:
Milo: upvote for 'Staging Whisperer' :+1:
Leo: also big thanks to @infra-team for spinning extra capacity mid-demo — appreciated.
Infra Team Bot: Thanks! Happy to help. :mechanical_arm:
Maya: ok team, pizza at 12:15 by the whiteboard. anyone bringing drinks?
Gina: I'll grab sodas. diet coke? :sunglasses:
Maya: perfect. see you all there — and again, massive thanks. :tada:
